metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description: Detects YellowKey Bitlocker Encryption bypass which allows attackers with physical access to bypass BitLocker encryption on Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022/2025
properties.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified", "FileRenamed")
| where isnotempty(FolderPath)
| where FolderPath has @"\System Volume Information\FsTx\"
     or FolderPath has @"\System Volume Information\FsTx$"
     or FileName =~ "FsTx"
| extend staging_target = FolderPath has "EFI" or FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\System Volume Information" or FolderPath has "System_Volume_Information"
  | project TimeGenerated, 
          DeviceName, 
          InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, 
          InitiatingProcessFolderPath, 
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FolderPath, 
          FileName, 
          ActionType, 
          staging_target
| extend
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessAccountName", "")),
    CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessCommandLine", ""))
| order by TimeGenerated desc
